name: Marrow
label: Marrow · gravelly storyteller
description: An old man with a deep, gravelly, slightly worn voice, as if from years of talking by fires. Slow, deliberate, with long pauses, a dry humour, and a tenderness that shows up when he least expects it. Built for bedtime stories, legends and tabletop games.
style: Slow and deliberate, with dramatic pauses. Let the ends of sentences fall.
refText: There was a door at the end of the corridor that nobody opened. Not because it was locked, you understand. Because of what had happened the last time somebody did.
author: Shell:B
